name: Bike Repair Stations
description: Dero Fixit public bike repair stations, Air Kit pumps, and wall-mount Tool Kits for trails, campuses, parks, and transit hubs. Authorized Dero dealer in Utah.
overview: Parkezza is an authorized Dero dealer in Utah, supplying Dero Fixit public bike repair stations for trailheads, campuses, parks, bike parking areas, transit stops, and HOA path networks. The Fixit holds the bike off the ground on hanger arms while riders use a full set of cable-tethered tools: Phillips and flat head screwdrivers; 2.5, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 8mm Allen wrenches; 8, 9, 10, 11, 15, and 32mm box wrenches; a T25 Torx wrench; and two tire levers. Add a Dero Air Kit pump with gauge, a wall-mounted Tool Kit for bike rooms and parking garages, and Air and Bike Repair signage with a QR code for repair how-tos. Pair stations with bike racks, benches, and litter receptacles for a complete cycling amenity.
